title: 第430章 锁定格局第429章 仗势欺人
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
“跟我来吧。”哲轻飘飘的落下一句话，便向着殿外走去，谢广鹏，秦玉霜还有苏少卿见状赶忙跟上去。
后山。
“宗主，我们以后怎么办？”谢广鹏有些犹豫了，但还是问出了口。
哲什么都没有说，只是继续向前走。
“把所有长老都叫过来吧。”哲道。
谢广鹏闻言，回头看了看秦玉霜，点了点头，随后秦玉霜便离开这里。
哲带着谢广鹏和苏少卿继续向前走，二人也不知道哲到底要去哪，只能跟着哲一直走。
不一会，秦玉霜带着其余三位长老来到这里。
“诸位，这一次联合，你们怎么看。”哲转身看向五位长老。
五位长老相互看了一眼，都没有说话，也许是不敢。
“哲叔，你太冲动了，我们现在估计已经是腹背受敌了，就算是要吞并，也不应该如此心急，现在我们只依靠你的实力镇压他们，这样是没有办法让他们臣服的，而且，这样做恐怕只会适得其反。”苏少卿倒是没有谢广鹏这些人的担忧，毕竟哲还能杀了他不成。
“那么如果是你，你会怎么解决这种情况。”哲反问道。
“按部就班，先联合，逐步确认统一思想，最后从他们的心理上，彻底让他们臣服。”苏少卿道。
“你是这样想的吗。”哲笑道。
“难道不是吗。”苏少卿反问道：“自古得民心者得天下，只靠铁血征服，终究只是外强中干。”
哲笑着看了看苏少卿，随后又看向五位长老。
“你们也是这样想的。”哲问道。
五位长老虽然明面上不敢说什么，但是心里在想什么，心知肚明。
“你们真的认为，你们可以说服他们联合。”哲反问着。
对于这个问题，在场众人对于答案显然都是了然于胸。

“就算失败，也不至于有太坏的后果。”赵磊试探性的开口。
“是吗。”哲挑眉看向赵磊，语气清淡，听不出半分怒意，却让赵磊刚鼓起的勇气瞬间溃散，下意识垂首闭口。
后山清风徐徐，林间枝叶轻响，可整片区域的气氛却压抑得令人窒息。
哲缓步转过身，目光扫过谢广鹏，秦玉霜几位长老，最后落在一脸笃定的苏少卿身上。
“你们都觉得，循序渐进，以德感化，慢慢收拢人心，是稳妥之法？”
哲轻笑一声，笑意微凉，带着看透世俗的漠然。
“你们终究还是看错了这些宗门，也看错了白夜谷数百年的割据乱象。”
苏少卿眉头微蹙。
content_en:
"Come with me." Zhe said lightly and walked out of the hall. Xie Guangpeng, Qin Yushuang and Su Shaoqing hurriedly followed after seeing this.
Back mountain.
"Sect Master, what should we do in the future?" Xie Guangpeng hesitated, but still asked.
Zhe didn't say anything and just kept walking forward.
"Call all the elders over," Zhe said.
Hearing this, Xie Guangpeng looked back at Qin Yushuang, nodded, and then Qin Yushuang left.
Zhe continued to move forward with Xie Guangpeng and Su Shaoqing. They didn't know where Zhe was going, so they could only follow Zhe.
After a while, Qin Yushuang came here with the other three elders.
"Everyone, what do you think of this alliance?" Zhe turned to look at the five elders.
The five elders looked at each other and said nothing, perhaps because they did not dare.
"Uncle Zhe, you are too impulsive. We are probably under attack from both sides now. Even if we want to annex, we shouldn't be so impatient. Now we only rely on your strength to suppress them. There is no way to make them surrender. Moreover, this may only be counterproductive." Su Shaoqing did not worry about people like Xie Guangpeng. After all, Zhe could still kill him.
"So if it were you, how would you solve this situation?" Zhe asked rhetorically.
"Step by step, unite first, gradually confirm the unified thinking, and finally make them surrender completely from their psychology." Su Shaoqing said.
"Is that what you think?" Zhe said with a smile.
"Isn't it?" Su Shaoqing asked rhetorically: "Since ancient times, those who win the hearts and minds of the people have won the world. Conquering only by iron and blood is ultimately just a powerful force on the outside."
Zhe looked at Su Shaoqing with a smile, and then looked at the five elders.
"You think so too." Zhe asked.
Although the five elders dare not say anything openly, they know what they are thinking in their hearts.
"Do you really think you can convince them to join forces?" Zhe asked rhetorically.
Regarding this question, everyone present obviously knew the answer.
"Even if it fails, there won't be too bad consequences." Zhao Lei said tentatively.
"Really?" Zhe raised his eyebrows and looked at Zhao Lei. His tone was calm, and there was no hint of anger. However, Zhao Lei's courage that he had just summoned instantly collapsed, and he subconsciously lowered his head and shut up.
There was a gentle breeze in the back mountain, and the branches and leaves in the forest rustled softly, but the atmosphere in the entire area was oppressive and suffocating.
Zhe turned around slowly, his eyes swept over Xie Guangpeng, Qin Yushuang and other elders, and finally landed on Su Shaoqing, who looked determined.
"Do you all think that proceeding step by step, using virtue to influence people, and slowly winning over people's hearts is the safe way?"
Zhe chuckled lightly, with a cold smile that showed the indifference of seeing through the world.
"After all, you have misunderstood these sects, and you have also misunderstood the hundreds of years of separatist chaos in Baiye Valley."
Su Shaoqing frowned slightly.
